name: leadpilot-ai
description: Find sales leads, identify conversations needing replies, draft grounded follow-ups, prepare booking options, and create sales briefings.

interface.longDescription: LeadPilot helps salespeople and small businesses identify high-intent leads, find conversations that need replies, draft grounded follow-ups, prepare meeting options from verified availability, and generate concise sales briefings. This MVP operates only on data supplied to its tools and does not send messages or create calendar events.
defaultPrompt: Find the strongest leads in these messages.
